decisions.statement: Every line answered is one JSON object.
The last line answered states the bound on the answer.
The bounding line states the count, the cursor, whether it is done and what clipped it.
A log line states the timestamp and the line and nothing else.
The bounding line is told from a log line by a key no log line has.
A pod name and a namespace are matched as literal strings rather than as patterns.
A window that clipped is answered as clipped rather than as complete.
A window check that could not run is answered as undetermined rather than as complete.
Reaching every line is bounded by the window and never by a line count.
A prefix matching nothing is an answer of no lines rather than a refusal.
Nothing here filters a log body.
A call saying no limit answers five hundred lines.
A call saying no window reaches back one hour.

definition: the command answering the log lines Loki has for a pod, newest first
